item.title: Swift Observatory's Fiery End: A Legacy Re-enters
item.description: After 22 years, NASA's Swift Observatory is falling to Earth. Explore its scientific legacy, the failed rescue, and the implications of its re-entry.

item.title: NASA’s $30M Swift Rescue Fails, Key Takeaways
item.description: NASA spent $30 million on a private rescue satellite, Link, to save the $500 million Swift Observatory, but a spin‑out failure forced abort.
